senses.gloss: m. (cmp. preced.) [a ball, cmp. אוּמְצָא,] a piece of meat, in gen. meat; [the Greek κοπάδιον is prob. an adaptation of our w.].
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:4:6">Y. Shek. V, end, 49ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>הא לך טימיתה וזיל זבין ק׳</he> (Bab. ed. <cite ref="S00522"><he>קופר</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>קופך בשר</he>, read <he>ד …</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) here is the price for it, go and buy a piece of meat.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:4">Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 6:4:3">Y. Shebi. VI, end, 37ᵃ</cite> <he>עבד ליה ק׳</he> he prepared a piece of meat for him.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni 2:3:4">Y. Maas. Sh. II, 53ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>קוּפְדָּה שמינה</he> a piece of fat meat.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>, beg. <he>ק׳ צלי</he> (some ed. <cite ref="S00522"><he>קופר</he></cite>) a piece of roast.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:10">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> (expl. <he>כי ציד וכ׳</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 25:28">Gen. XXV, 28</cite>) <he>קופרא טבא וכ׳</he> a good piece of meat—for his (Isaac’s) mouth, a good cup of wine &c.; Yalk. ib. 110 <cite ref="S00522"><he>קופרא</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 44b:1">Ber. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>על מיני ק׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="S00522"><he>קופרא</he></cite>; Ms. M. <he>על הקופרא</he>) over all kinds of meat dishes.—Pl. <cite ref="S00499"><he>קוּפְדָּן</he></cite>, <he>קוּפְדִּין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:2:6">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חמון קופדן</he> look at these pieces of flesh (on his body)!; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>קפדון</he> (read: <he>ין …</he>, some ed. <cite ref="S01702"><he>קפדן</he></cite>, oth. <he>קפרן</he>); <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:13:1">Koh. R. to V, 13</cite> <he>קופדין</he> (some ed. <he>קופר׳</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 8:3:5">Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵃ</cite> <he>מקטעתה ק׳ וכ׳</he> to cut it in pieces and sell it in the market.
